note: Positions of regional entries found by reading the entry's stored documents (Claude Opus 5.5, in the session, on the owner's instruction of 20 Nov 2026: 'You need to use your own AI budget here to figure this out'). Each record names the site, a quotation copied from a stored document that ties the entry to the site, and the position's source: either coordinates printed in a stored document (doc + printed, copied as printed, OCR slips included) or an English Wikipedia article whose page gives coordinates. No coordinate is typed in. node scripts/review-positions.mjs checks each record against the stored texts and the kept Wikipedia look-ups and writes 'checked'; only a record that passes can be approved (scripts/approve-positions.mjs).
